    return {'top':bnd(10),'bot':bnd(40),'c':bbox(cc),'y':bbox(yy)}

def feats(fr):
    rows = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    def bnd(r):
        idx=[c for c in range(64) if rows[r][c]=='G']
        return (min(idx),max(idx)) if idx else None
    cc=[(r,c) for r in range(40,56) for c in range(64) if rows[r][c]=='c']
    yy=[(r,c) for r in range(40,56) for c in range(64) if rows[r][c]=='Y']
    def bbox(pts):
        if not pts: return None
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return {'top':bnd(10),'bot':bnd(40),'c':bbox(cc),'y':bbox(yy)}
